title: Permutations and combinations: topic test
description: A 25-minute test on permutations and combinations: 13 questions, 20 marks, from quick questions to longer answers. Questions are drawn at random from the question bank, so every attempt is different.
instructions:
Answer every question. You have 25 minutes.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly.
